summary: Avis Budget Group, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that its wholly-owned subsidiaries issued $300 million aggregate principal amount of 8.000% Senior Notes due 2031 as additional notes under an existing indenture. The new notes are part of the same series as $500 million previously issued. Proceeds will be used to redeem a portion of its 5.750% Senior Notes due 2027 and pay fees. The notes are senior unsecured guarantees by the parent and certain subsidiaries. This is a routine debt issuance and refinancing, not a special situation event.
